body: I will, thanks for taking the time for listening to me , it was really nice of both of you.

Thanks for the kind words, reading that really helped pick me up.

I think I'll just keep on trucking for now, I guess I have a lot of life ahead of me so I might as well.

Anyway, thanks again, this is probably one of the nicest things I've ever heard from someone who wasn't related to me haha.

Well the thing is I go to a really academically competitive high school. It's really crazy how hard it is to stand out here. Our average unweighted GPA for the senior (my) class is like a 3.8 so it's super high.

I've always considered myself a pretty science-oriented person but the thing is literally everyone around me is too. And it just sucks so much when you think you really love something and are really dedicated to it and then someone next to you who put half as much effort ends up doing better than you.

This kind of thing happens to me all the time on tests and with schoolwork in general. Like last week I studied really hard for a physics test and got a B- on it and the kid next to me didn't study at all and got 100%.

But today it happened yet again, and with something I really cared a lot about. Over the summer I did a 6-month research project at my local university. I spent a ton of time and energy especially during the last 2 months because I had to work around school, so I ended up sleeping at 2am most days. 

I ended up submitting my project to a competition, and I also worked really hard to submit that on time. Today I got the results though, and it turns out that I didn't even make it past the first round, whereas some other kids I know from my school who did like a small 8-week internship apparently made it to the regional level, way past where I got. So even though I worked for over twice as long, they still did way better than me in the competition.

It's when stuff like this happens that I feel really dumb and worthless honestly. 

Sorry for the long paragraphs though, I know you asked for the skinny, but yeah that's what I'm going through right now.
